your_ideas.idea-1: Export and import all app data to CSV and JSON files.
your_ideas.idea-2: Export data to a connected Google Sheet.
your_ideas.idea-3: Goals, habits and challenges: e.g. 'save $400/month' or 'save $8,000 by year-end', with AI-driven suggestions and trackers that read your real data and recommend cuts like 'save 5% on hobbies, groceries, rent or loans'.
your_ideas.idea-4: Track expenses and income by category and visualize them with charts and graphs.

smart_money.idea-5: Auto-categorization with confidence score: rules engine plus learning from your past corrections, showing a small confidence badge and a one-tap 'fix and remember' so it gets smarter over time.
smart_money.idea-6: Recurring and subscription radar: automatically detect recurring charges (Netflix, gym, insurance), flag price increases and forgotten subscriptions, and surface total monthly recurring spend.
smart_money.idea-7: Cash-flow forecast: project end-of-month and end-of-year balance from recurring income, fixed costs and average variable spend, with a 'safe-to-spend today' number.
smart_money.idea-8: Anomaly and duplicate detection: alert on unusual spikes, possible duplicate transactions, or a category running hot vs. its usual baseline.

insight_and_motivation.idea-9: Weekly and monthly money digest: a clean auto-generated summary (top categories, vs. last period, biggest single expense, savings rate) delivered in-app and optionally by email.
insight_and_motivation.idea-10: Savings rate as the hero metric: surface savings rate (income minus expenses / income) as a primary, prominently tracked number, since it's the single best health indicator.
insight_and_motivation.idea-11: What-if simulator: 'If I cut dining by 20%, I reach my $8,000 goal 6 weeks earlier' — interactive sliders tied to real goals from idea-3.
insight_and_motivation.idea-12: Net worth tracking over time: combine accounts, cash, and manual assets/liabilities into a single net-worth trend line, not just monthly cash flow.

experience_and_trust.idea-13: Privacy-first / local-first mode: option to keep data on-device or self-export anytime, marketed as a key differentiator vs. cloud-only competitors.
experience_and_trust.idea-14: Multi-currency support with daily FX: track accounts and trips in different currencies, normalized to a base currency for reporting.
experience_and_trust.idea-15: Shared / household spaces: split a budget or specific categories with a partner or family, with per-member visibility controls.
experience_and_trust.idea-16: Receipt capture and attach: snap a photo, OCR the amount and merchant, and attach it to the transaction for warranties and expense proof.
experience_and_trust.idea-17: Full bilingual ES/EN from day one, including number, date and currency formatting per locale (already aligned with the MVP plan).

top_picks_to_stand_out: idea-3 (goals with AI suggestions from real data)
